lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: She screamed. You couldn't stop it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: The blade is speaking.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That weapon has been resonating ever since I pulled you from the void.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Some blades carry combat records. Yours carries something else. I think... I think it's carrying you.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: How many?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I don't know yet. But it's giving them back faster than I expected. Whatever the killswitch did, it didn't finish you, it locked you. We need to move.

lines.speaker: Rustfang Scout 1
lines.text: Contact. Derelict Corsair-class. No transponder. Claim it.

lines.speaker: Rustfang Scout 2
lines.text: Breach the ramp! Move!

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: High guard. Third taught you this.

lines.speaker: Rustfang Scout 3
lines.text: Operative! Operative!

lines.speaker: Rustfang Scout 4
lines.text: Fall back! Signal the...

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I wasn't always a salvager.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I was Dominion. An operative, same as you, different generation, no blade.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Six years ago a raid went bad. I was pinned, written off, left to bleed. One of you was on that line, you could have stepped over me. You pulled me out instead.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I deserted within the month. Couldn't wear the uniform after a man I was sent to kill saved my life. Been drifting the fringe as a salvager ever since.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: The blade. How is this possible?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Your blade didn't come with the ship. It came bonded to you, neural-locked to your augmented nervous system before they wiped you.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I think when the killswitch misfired, instead of erasing your memories it locked them into the only thing that could outlast the chip. The steel itself.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: He is correct. We are a ledger written in carbon and iron.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Then we use it. We go to the Archive. We get the rest before Khall's people find you.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Corona Archive shows on old salvage maps. Believed decommissioned twelve years ago. If there are files left, they'll still be registered to your biometrics.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Whatever they made you, the record of it is in there. We get it before Khall's people do.

lines.speaker: Drone 1
lines.text: Target locked. Evasion countermeasures active.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: Precision, not aggression. You learned this form in silence.

lines.speaker: Drone 2
lines.text: First unit down. Engaging alternate vector. Firing...

lines.speaker: Drone 3
lines.text: Disengaging to beacon deploy...

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Beacon fired before it died. We have company coming. How long to Archive?

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Seventeen minutes at current vector.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Docking sequence initiated. Archive is cold. No active defenses detected, but the station knows you're here.

lines.speaker: Archive Ghost Signal
lines.text: Welcome, Operative Ronin-7. Your reactivation has been logged.

lines.speaker: Archive Ghost Signal
lines.text: Your biometrics match file RONIN-SEVENTH-GENERATION. Clearance granted to archives one through nine.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: It still thinks I'm coming home.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: They always intended to call you back. The erasure was meant to be temporary, a reset. Had the killswitch done its job, you would have activated, returned here, and been remade. It didn't. You walked away with the gaps instead.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: They expect you to rebuild yourself for whatever comes next.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We can recover everything, every file, every record. Or we can burn the Archive down and let the ghosts sleep.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That answers that.

lines.speaker: Sentry 1
lines.text: Intruder detected. Detainment protocol engaged.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: Pivot on the wave-pressure. The cadence was always three-beat. You were always graceful in the void.

lines.speaker: Sentry 1
lines.text: Welcome home, brother.

lines.speaker: Sentry 2
lines.text: Welcome home, brother.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: If you're watching this, the reset failed.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Strength that questions is weakness. The orphanage was a lesson. Mercy and duty are incompatible.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: You were tested. You were broken. Now we remake you.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: He lied. The orphanage was not a lesson.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: What you did that night is why he triggered the killswitch. The truth of it is buried deeper than he wants you to dig.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: What did I do?

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: Not yet. The memory will tear you open if it arrives before you can hold it. Find the ones who survived that night. Let them tell you what they saw.

lines.speaker: Enforcer
lines.text: Operative Ronin-7. You are classified as escaped asset. Return to Dominion custody.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: He leads with the high parry. You taught him that. Use it.

lines.speaker: Enforcer
lines.text: I'm sorry, brother. I didn't have a Kessler.

lines.speaker: Archive Terminal
lines.text: File load successful. Displaying intake record: OPERATIONAL CHILD SPECIMEN, COHORT RONIN-SEVENTH.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: What is my name?

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: Not yet. You are not ready. The gaps are still raw, pull too hard and they tear.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: When the chip is silenced, I will show you everything. Every memory. Every name the Dominion tried to burn away.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The alarms are triggering now. He knows you're here.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: All operatives are compelled to return to Dominion custody.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Non-compliance triggers involuntary termination. Ronin-7, your time ends now.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: He commands a battleship at the Reaches' edge. He will burn this station and chase you across every corridor between stars.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We go. Now.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We find the others who survived. We make this harder for him.

lines.speaker: Interceptor 1
lines.text: Corsair departing. Weapons free. Converge.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Starboard thruster degrading! Compensate!

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: The star remembers you. It always has.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We're clear. Jumping now.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I pulled everything before we fled. Look.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: Count them.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: How many of us?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You were never a program. You were a harvest.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: Every numbered child is still in here. Every one who broke. Every moment they tried to make you forget. We carry them all.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: How long has this been happening?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Longer than either of us has been alive.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: There. The roster entry.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: We're not unique.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: No. But you broke. They ordered the unthinkable, and you carried it out, and then something in you refused to keep being their weapon. That break is the proof the system can fail.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: Find the others. The flagged ones. The ones still in the vaults. The ones still being processed. That is why I remember.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Then we go. We find them.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The ledger's flagged entries are real. Anomalous, unresolved, operatives who broke conditioning and lived. Like you.

lines.speaker: Katana
lines.text: One signal repeats in the deep registers. A woman's cadence. Ninth generation.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Then we follow it. We find her before Khall does.
